story.title: Tamil Nadu Police Used IT Rules to Ask X to Block 18 URLs Belonging to Ruling Party's Critics
story.summary: Tamil Nadu Police invoked Section 79(3)(b) of India's IT Act to request that X (formerly Twitter) block 18 URLs, which allegedly belong to DMK supporters who shared commentary criticising the Tamil Viduthalai Kazhagam party and the Chief Minister's office. The requests represent a pattern of state-level police agencies using federal IT law powers to suppress political speech online, bypassing judicial oversight. The incident adds to a growing record of India's content takedown infrastructure being used against domestic political dissent rather than solely for national security or harm-prevention purposes.
use_cases: platform compliance with state police requests
